novelty_review.scope: Internal engineering review for native validation; not external acceptance
novelty_review.rationale: A spring-loaded access plate can rise and tip until the threaded nuts capture its load. The expert transfers support between hands to reach both rows, turns and regrips every nut, and releases a level, compressed plate. This replaces an independent-nut repetition task.
novelty_review.risk: Highest contact and runtime risk. Fine compound thread collision, repeated regrasping and load transfer must pass native probes before any paid model trial. RoboDojo already tests independent threaded pairs.

review_notes: Passive mechanics, source-defined contact geometry, measured-state controller and native probes implemented. Offline geometry cannot establish physical success. No task may enter the submission handoff before runtime evidence passes.
